A project's command runs even when its profile is only half filled.

### Changed

- `monkeys run` next to a `.monkeys` file no longer refuses when a listed key
  has no secret remembered. It names the missing keys in one line and runs the
  command without them. When the command fails, it adds the `monkeys remember`
  lines a human types, and the command's exit status is kept.
- Keys named on the command line still stop the run before it starts.
